newsitem.title: USA: FelCor Suite gets credit line, sees charge.
newsitem.headline: FelCor Suite gets credit line, sees charge.

text.p: FelCor Suite Hotels Inc said on Thursday it received a $250 million, three-year, unsecured revolving line of credit co-arranged by the Chase Manhattan Bank and Wells Fargo Bank.
FelCor also said it will post a $2.4 million third quarter charge from the retirement of existing debt.
The hotel real estate investment trust said the credit line gives it a means to continue its expansion strategy, while cutting borrowing costs.
"This should enable FelCor to achieve a superior return on equity while retaining a conservative balance sheet," chairman Hervey Feldman said in a statement.
The new $250 million line of credit is priced according to a ratings-based pricing matrix with an initial interest rate of LIBOR plus 175 basis points, the company said.
Felcor said it retired a $65 million secured loan through the conversion of an existing credit facility to an $85 million 4-year secured term loan at an interest rate of LIBOR plus 150 basis points.
